Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

course — a series of lessons. Example: In this course I learnt a lot.
present — to speak in front of people. Example: I present my project.
progress — movement towards a goal. Example: My progress is good.
skill — something you can do well. Example: My best skill is listening.
summary — a short description of the main points. Example: This is my summary.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• In this course I learnt ...
• My best skill is ...
• I can now ...
• Next I am going to ...
• Thank you for listening.
